item.description:
• Significantly reduced memory usage (RAM) by up to 70% and improved energy efficiency through optimized background monitoring.
  • Enhanced application performance with aggressive window lifecycle management and optimized particle animations.
  • Restructured settings interface by moving intervals into break sections and refining sound options for better focus.
  • Simplified break behavior with 5-minute default delays and unlimited delay options.
  • Enhanced debug capabilities with isolated storage and quick testing intervals for better stability.
